about_the_game:
The second volume of the original soundtrack for the mobile game NieR Re[in]carnation!

It includes a total of 18 tracks from the main story "The Sun and the Moon". Please enjoy the delicately woven melodies of Keiichi Okabe and Shotaro Seo (MONACA).

*NieR Re[in]carnation was the first mobile title in the NieR series, released in February 2021. (The service has since been discontinued.)
